_comment: Canonical EN body-text labels used by build_translations.py to translate inline article chrome (Published, Updated, Sources & references, etc.) — distinct from strings.json which is global UI chrome. Every other _data/i18n/<lang>/labels.json must carry the same key set; CI gate test_i18n_labels.py enforces parity.
